query: SELECT ?name ?pos WHERE { ?t ex:inGroup ?g . ?g rdfs:label "Group A" . ?p ex:playsFor ?t ; rdfs:label ?name . GENOP("On which position does the footballer {?name} primarily play? Answer with one of Goalkeeper, Defender, Midfielder or Forward. If you do not know this player, answer Unknown.", (?pos), <model>) FILTER(?pos = "Defender") }
